GTU DEPARTMENT OF ARCHITECTURE
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION FOR GRADUATE STUDY
Two letters of recommendation are required for graduate study applications . The last term students who will apply for a master's degree will be able to take from the two faculty members they take courses in undergraduate program. If you are a graduate and have worked or are working in a workplace , you can also get them from your workplace supervisors . If you are applying for a doctorate program, one of your letters must be from your master thesis advisor and you can also get the other one from the lecturer you studied the most , or from your supervisors if you have worked or are working in a workplace .
The letter of recommendation may be filled in Turkish or English .
